subject: Intro: Redwood initial discovery — finding a kickoff slot & ops checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@aureliasys.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aureliasys.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Redwood initial discovery — finding a kickoff slot & ops checklist

Hi Priya and Liam — great to meet (virtually) last week. As discussed, we'd like to run a 45–60 minute initial discovery/kickoff to: (1) confirm goals and success criteria, (2) surface security/procurement touchpoints, and (3) do a high-level walkthrough of the Redwood hosted + private deployment options that map to your data constraints.

Proposed agenda (attached as a one-pager):
- 5m intros and success criteria (Aurelia champion + AE)
- 20m technical intake (SE + engineering lead) — architecture, data paths, latency SLAs
- 15m procurement & compliance asks (procurement/security representative)
- 5–10m next steps & mutual action plan

Proposed windows (PST):
- Thu Apr 13 — 09:30–10:30 or 14:00–15:00
- Fri Apr 14 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:30–16:30

If none of those work, please tell us two slots that do and we’ll triage. I’ve cc'd Soojin (SE) who will run the technical portion, and Dev (solutions ops) to help with DocuSign/contract routing and calendar invitations.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]
From: Priya Rao <priya@aureliasys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aureliasys.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood initial discovery — finding a kickoff slot & ops checklist

Hi Jordan — thanks, that agenda looks good. Quick notes from our side:
- Liam (engineering lead) prefers mornings; Thu the 13th at 09:30PT would work best for the core team.
- We need to loop in Procurement and our InfoSec lead — copying Procurement and Anika (InfoSec) here.
- For the technical intake, Liam will want to review the expected network topology and any required egress rules ahead of time.

Procurement: if possible, can someone from Redwood share the standard procurement checklist or contract intake form before the call?

Thanks — Priya
Priya Rao
Director of Product, Aurelia Systems
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@aureliasys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@aureliasys.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aureliasys.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@aureliasys.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 13:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood initial discovery — finding a kickoff slot & ops checklist

Hi all — thanks for the invite. A couple quick asks from InfoSec before we commit to a pilot timeline:
- Basic evidence: do you have a recent SOC 2 snapshot or a product security questionnaire we can consume?
- Data isolation: we need to confirm whether your Hosted offering encrypts model cache at rest and whether there are options for VPC/private deployment.

If you can push those docs ahead of the 13th call that would be ideal and will save time.

Cheers,
Anika Shah
InfoSec Manager, Aurelia Systems
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@aureliasys.com>, Priya Rao <priya@aureliasys.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aureliasys.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood initial discovery — finding a kickoff slot & ops checklist

Hi Anika / team — appreciate the specifics. Attached is a short SOC2 snapshot and a one-page note on our deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). I’ve also dropped a short network diagram in the shared Drive link below.

Attachments: soc2-snapshot.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aurelia-Redwood-Kickoff

For the call on Thu Apr 13 at 09:30PT, planned attendees from Redwood: Jordan (AE), Soojin (SE), Dev (Solutions Ops). We’ll allocate time to go over the network diagram and to capture any procurement gating items.

Sooj
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Procurement <procurement@aureliasys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@aureliasys.com>, Anika Shah <anika.shah@aureliasys.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aureliasys.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood initial discovery — finding a kickoff slot & ops checklist

Thanks — we’re good to keep Thu Apr 13 at 09:30PT on our calendars. Two actionable items from procurement side: (1) please complete the contract intake form (link below) and (2) include a high-level enterprise pricing bucket so we can route budget approval internally.

Contract intake form: https://procure.aureliasys.com/forms/vendor-intake?rid=AZ4987
Pricing guidance: please send a one-paragraph note with the expected billing model (hosted per-token + dedicated reserve option) and any minimum commitment assumptions.

We look forward to the call.

—Procurement Team
Aurelia Systems
